items.text: My concerns about harm to this neighborhood would be acted upon if I raised them with the outside.
items.blockHelp: Willingness to speak up about harm, Mahoney's six verbal-vigilance items, with "the outside" (the city, the funders, the service institutions) in place of "management/leadership."
items.scene: A resident tells the county caseworker that the new intake form is turning families away. The caseworker says she'll pass it on. Nothing changes. The next resident who notices something says nothing, and would tell you, if asked, that there is no point.
